sentences.en: It's famous for other reasons, too. Corcoran real estate broker Alex Nicholas says anthropologist Margaret Mead and poet Edna St. Vincent Millay once called it home.
sentences.vi: Nó cũng nổi tiếng vì những lý do khác. Nhà môi giới bất động sản tại Corcoran, Alex Nicholas, cho biết nhà nhân chủng học Margaret Mead và nhà thơ Edna St. Vincent Millay từng gọi nó là nhà.

sentences.en: It's interesting to note, also, that neither the US Army nor the Obama regime has yet to publically state exactly what Specialist Millay was arrested for.

sentences.en: A small plaque on the house notes that poet Edna St. Vincent Millay once lived there; so did anthropologist Margaret Mead.
